name: Wet Paint Drip Button

description.zh: 深色背景上一枚电光紫蓝的圆角矩形按钮，底边垂下数条粗细不一的漆滴，末端带圆头，像刚刷完未干的油漆正在往下淌。白色 Poppins 粗体字居中，圆角仅 4px，整体是扁平色块加有机液态轮廓的对比。
description.en: On a near-black backdrop sits an electric indigo rounded rectangle whose bottom edge sags into several uneven paint drips with rounded tips, as if freshly brushed and still wet. Centered white Poppins semibold text, only 4px radius, contrasting a flat colour block with an organic liquid silhouette.

reconstructionPrompt: Build a dark-page CTA button: background #615fff, white Poppins 600 16px text, padding 10px 16px, border-radius 4px, transition 0.15s. Add an SVG/CSS pseudo-element along the bottom edge forming 4-5 uneven drips with rounded caps. On hover, animate drips stretching downward and detaching into circular droplets that fall and fade, looping infinitely with staggered delays per drip. Keep the label static and centered.
